processes.name: Order to Cash
processes.description: From customer order received to payment cleared.

steps.name: Receive order (email/phone)
steps.description: Orders captured from email, phone, and a web form, then re-keyed into the ERP.
painPoints: Orders arrive in 3 channels, manually re-keyed

steps.name: Quote approval
painPoints: Every quote waits for manager sign-off, even small ones

steps.name: Invoice & collect payment
painPoints: Invoices re-typed from the order; ~40% need correction

processes.name: Supplier Restock
processes.description: From low-stock detection to purchase order raised.

steps.name: Detect low stock
painPoints: No automatic reorder point; spotted by eye on the shelf

opportunities.title: Unify order intake
opportunities.problem: Orders are re-keyed from three channels; about 30% carry an error into the rest of the process.
opportunities.proposedSolution: An Airtable intake form plus automations that consolidate email/phone/web orders into one validated queue feeding the ERP.

aiViability.existingFeature: No suitable intake-dedup feature in the current ERP.
aiViability.noCodeAi: An LLM step in the automation can classify and normalise free-text/phone-noted orders before they hit the ERP.
aiViability.customAgent: A bespoke agent is overkill at ~35 orders/day.
aiViability.rationale: Lowest rung that reliably handles three messy intake channels.

rejectedAlternatives: custom-claude-build: order volume too low to justify a bespoke agent plus its maintenance.

sellBack.build: Airtable base + intake automations + ERP sync

opportunities.title: Auto-approve small quotes
opportunities.problem: Every quote waits for manager sign-off, adding ~8h of queue even for trivial amounts.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Enable the ERP's existing approval-threshold setting so quotes under a value auto-approve.

aiViability.existingFeature: The ERP already supports approval thresholds — no AI needed.
aiViability.rationale: A configuration toggle the client already owns solves it outright.

rejectedAlternatives: no-code-automation: unnecessary when the ERP can do this natively.

opportunities.title: Automate invoicing
opportunities.problem: Invoices are re-typed from the order and ~40% need correction, delaying payment by a day or more.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Connect the order system to the accounting package so invoices generate from the confirmed order.

aiViability.existingFeature: Accounting package has e-invoicing but it isn't connected to orders.
aiViability.noCodeAi: An AI step could reconcile mismatched line items during migration.
aiViability.customAgent: Not warranted for standard invoice generation.
aiViability.rationale: The data plumbing is the real fix; existing e-invoicing covers the rest.

rejectedAlternatives: custom-claude-build: standard invoice generation needs no bespoke AI.

opportunities.title: Automatic reorder points
opportunities.problem: Low stock is spotted by eye, so restock can wait up to two days before anyone notices.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Adopt an inventory tool with reorder-point alerts that watches stock levels and flags items to reorder.

aiViability.existingFeature: Off-the-shelf inventory tools include demand-forecasting AI in higher tiers.
aiViability.noCodeAi: Optional later; not needed for basic reorder thresholds.
aiViability.rationale: A standard inventory product solves detection without any custom work.

rejectedAlternatives: custom-claude-build: a mature SaaS category already exists.

sellBack.build: Inventory tool selection + setup + reorder rules

opportunities.title: AI order-triage agent
opportunities.problem: Free-text and phoned-in orders need interpretation that a simple form can't capture.
opportunities.proposedSolution: A custom Claude agent that reads any inbound order, extracts structured line items, and queries the customer for missing detail.

aiViability.existingFeature: No off-the-shelf feature handles this client's idiosyncratic phone orders.
aiViability.noCodeAi: A no-code LLM step covers the common cases (see opp_001).
aiViability.customAgent: Justified only if volume and edge-case complexity grow well beyond today.
aiViability.rationale: Reserved for the Transform scenario; not recommended at current volume.

rejectedAlternatives: Included only to show the high-complexity option that opp_001 deliberately avoids today.

scenarios.name: Quick Wins
scenarios.narrative: Low-effort changes deliverable in 2–3 weeks: a configuration the client already owns, a standard inventory tool, and a consolidated intake form.

scenarios.name: Automate the Core
scenarios.narrative: Builds on the quick wins by connecting orders to accounting, removing the largest single source of delay and rework.

scenarios.name: Transform
scenarios.narrative: The full programme, including a bespoke AI order-triage agent — recommended only if order volume and complexity grow.
